name: recorder
description: Keeps a record of every run of the command-line tool being written, whoever ran it: its arguments, how it exited, how long it took, what it consumed and what it wrote to each stream, in a pane and as tools Claude reads

pollSeconds.title: Seconds between reads
pollSeconds.description: How often the records are read once a tool is watched, so a run made in another terminal shows in the pane. 0 reads them only when asked: on /recorder, on Refresh, after a command of Claude's and when Claude calls a tool.
